description: This file defines a generic class 'AzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler' that handles recording stream delivery failures to Azure Table Storage within the Orleans framework. It manages failure entities, initializes storage, and provides methods for error handling related to stream delivery and subscription failures.

classes.name: AzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler<TEntity>
classes.description: A handler that logs delivery failures to Azure Table Storage for a specific stream, and manages faulting subscriptions based on failure conditions.

methods.name: AzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the failure handler with storage options, logger factory, and optional entity creation logic.

methods.name: InitAsync
methods.description: Initializes the Azure table storage for failure logging.

methods.name: OnDeliveryFailure
methods.description: Records a delivery failure after maximum retries, for a specific subscription and stream.

methods.name: OnSubscriptionFailure
methods.description: Records a subscription failure after maximum retries, for a specific subscription and stream.

methods.name: OnFailure
methods.description: Common private method that creates and stores a failure entity in Azure Table Storage.
